definitions.original: Byte-identical collected file. Raw API/log/artifact data, independent derived reviews, author receipts and author identity records have distinct kinds and retain their own scope; this term is not an external audit or code-signing claim.
definitions.complete_job_log: One preserved complete log, including successful and cancelled attempts. A log count is not a count of successful logical gates. Exact selected successful attempts and aliases are defined by the final native audit and CI summary.
definitions.historical_pending: Frozen historical, preliminary, initial and rejected observations retain their original PENDING wording. Their status is not the current-stage acceptance decision.
definitions.alias: Two job IDs mapping to identical execution timestamps or identical log bytes are not extra test executions. Consult native attempt mapping.

this_manifest: Excluded from its own inventory and hash to avoid self-reference.

integrity_checks.stored_commit_blob_comparison: Final documentation review must compare these expected blob IDs against the exact documentation tree.

exclusions: Reproducible upload checkpoints and temporary working files are not audit originals.
Previous stages remain in their original repository paths; they are not duplicated or reclassified as current archive evidence.

Large operator executable bundle ZIPs and binaries are not embedded in this evidence directory. The collected API metadata, original bundle manifests and per-member verification inventories record their checks; the final native audit states their artifact retention and scope. Payment-resource ZIPs are separately preserved byte-for-byte.
The final documentation commit and its review/merge receipt are recorded in the documentation PR linked from runtime PR #13, outside this commit to avoid self-reference.
